Plot spatial cell-type annotations

Source: R/cell_type_runner.R
plot_spatial_annotation.Rd

Plot cell-type annotations stored in the colData of SpatialExperiment objects across normalisation methods.

Usage

plot_spatial_annotation(
  norm_list,
  annotation_col = "SingleR_label",
  method_order = NULL,
  point_size = 0.5,
  palette = NULL,
  ncol = 1,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

norm_list

Named list of annotated SpatialExperiment objects.

annotation_col

Name of the colData column containing cell-type annotations.

method_order

Optional character vector specifying the order of normalisation methods.

point_size

Point size for spatial locations.

palette

Colour palette. One of "viridis", "magma", "inferno", "plasma", "cividis", "rocket", "mako", "turbo", or a custom character vector of colours. If NULL, the default ggplot2 palette is used.

ncol

Number of facet columns.

theme_name

Plot theme. One of "classic", "bw", "minimal", or "gray".

Value

A list containing plotting data and plot.

Examples

data(norm_example)

p <- plot_spatial_annotation(
  norm_list = norm_example,
  annotation_col = "cell_type",
  point_size = 0.5,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

p$plot
